Conservation Area
Impact</span></b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:36.0pt;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The
proposed development, by reason of its siting, scale, form, proportions and
architectural approach, would appear as an incongruous and visually constrained
form of development that would fail to respond appropriately to the prevailing
character, appearance and spatial qualities of the surrounding area. The
proposal would result in the permanent infilling of a frontage parcel which
contributes to the openness and character of the Roxborough Park Conservation
Area, causing less than substantial harm to its significance. This harm would
not be outweighed by the public benefits of the proposal. Accordingly, the
proposal would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the
Roxborough Park Conservation Area and would conflict with Section 72(1) of the
Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Paragraphs 212 and
215 of the National Planning Policy Framework, Policies D2, D3 and HC1 of the
London Plan (2021) and Policies GR1, GR10, HO3 and HE1 of the Harrow Local Plan
(2021-2041).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:36.0pt;text-align:justify;
text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Arial">3.<span style="font:7.0pt &quot;Times New Roman&quot;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span></span></b><!--[endif]--><b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Flood Risk &amp; Drainage
Information</span></b><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-bidi-font-weight:bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:36.0pt;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">The
applicant has failed to provide sufficient information to adequately assess
flood risk and drainage associated with the proposed development, including
details relating to finished floor levels, safe access and egress, flood
resilience and resistance measures, surface water drainage, sustainable
drainage features and their ongoing maintenance. In the absence of this
information, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied that the proposal
would appropriately manage flood risk, provide safe access during flood events
or adequately manage surface water runoff. The proposal therefore conflicts
with Policy SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021), Policy C4 of the Harrow
Local Plan (2021-2041) and the flood risk and drainage objectives of the
National Planning Policy Framework.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
